title: Rory and the Starry Blossom Ridge
verses:
The sun had gone down past the edge of the hill,
A breeze blew so soft in the air,
And Rory stood listening, peaceful and still,
With time for a moment to share.

Above them swept Nia through ribbons of pink,
To see where the blossom beds grow,
While Psittaco nestled and started to blink,
And chirped to the others below.

Then Ricky slowed down on the mossy green track,
And yawned as he looked at the sky,
While Tilly nudged pebbles to help guide him back,
As sleepy night shadows rolled by.

Then Benny stepped out to the center of grass,
And swept all the leaves in a ring,
To welcome the dreams that would quietly pass,
While crickets were starting to sing.

And Rory crept close to his welcoming friends,
To settle down under the moon,
Where quietness falls as the daytime now ends,
While humming a lullaby tune.

The petals all folded their blankets of blue,
The valley was tucked into sleep,
And all through the darkness, till morning shines new,
Their dreams would be gentle and deep.
